title: GTA 6 Has Two Leads: Meet Jason and Lucia

lines.text: GTA 6 has two leads, not one. Meet Jason and Lucia.
lines.caps: GTA 6 has | *TWO leads, | not one. | Meet *Jason | and *Lucia.

lines.text: Lucia Caminos. She just got out of Leonida Penitentiary, thanks to a stroke of luck.
lines.caps: *Lucia Caminos. | Just out of | *Leonida Penitentiary, | a *stroke of luck.

lines.text: Now she has a plan to change the odds in her favor, no matter what it takes.
lines.caps: Now she has | a *plan | to change *the odds, | *no matter what.

lines.text: Jason Duval. An Army vet, now doing jobs for local criminals in the Keys.
lines.caps: *Jason Duval. | An *Army vet, | doing jobs | in *the Keys.

lines.text: When the easy life slips away, he falls back on what he knows.
lines.caps: When the *easy life | *slips away, | he falls back | on *what he knows.

lines.text: Then he meets Lucia, and Rockstar says she could be the best, or the worst, thing that ever happened to him.
lines.caps: Then he meets *Lucia. | She could be | the *best, | or the *worst, | thing for him.

lines.text: Two people, one plan, all of Leonida. Out November nineteenth.
Part two is your call: A, the other Leonida characters, or B, how much bigger the map is than GTA 5?
